fills: Full fractional-share fills at fresh finite positive recorded minute opens; no bid/ask, partial fill, queue, minimum lot, participation or market impact model
universe: Retrospective static 2026 universe and GICS taxonomy; no point-in-time investability claim
timing: Completed-close decisions; primary origin+2 open, stresses origin+3 and origin+5; no variable processing/feed latency
closing: Begin flattening five minutes before final close; fresh final-close fallback; carry and invalidate unavailable residuals
cash: Zero interest and risk-free return; long-only portfolio SR does not establish market-neutral alpha
borrow: 3 percent annual short market value, 10 percent stress, no historical locate constraints; zero-borrow diagnostic for long-short
train: Normalize, PCA, volume baseline and pooled forecast horizon calibration on first60 earlier sessions only; horizon labels remain inside fitting cutoff
evaluation: Five chronological development blocks; later replay previously research-exposed; no untouched holdout claim; 20 initial cash warmup days included per cohort
sizing: New sleeve daily-vol budget .005/sqrt390/minuteSD, capped .04; operating gross .9, sector .2 LO or sector-net .04 LS; hard gross1/stock.05/sector.25 LO or sector-net.05 LS
exits: Stateful share holdings; new/changed sleeves enter at delayed open, completed-close exits have identical delay; risk corrections and closing cannot be blocked
inventory: S04 partial adjustment and daily turnover budget reserve exit dollars; actual cap breaches invalidate the run
S09: Equal average sector and industry leave-self-out peer moves, with sector leave-self-out directional breadth and at most two sector event bars per day
S02: Fixed fit-period-coverage eligible industry constituents for equal-dollar hedge baskets; not beta-neutral
S03: Pooled OLS intercept/slope calibrate persistent mean forecasts to directly measured residual return horizon on fit period only
inference: Daily Sharpe sqrt252; five-session moving block bootstrap; all trials and risk shadows disclosed; no search-adjusted significance claim
